create.name: Hannah Muse
create.bio:
Hannah Muse teaches yoga, meditation and the mythology of the yoga tradition from Santa Cruz, California. Her root teacher was Baba Hari Dass, and her meditation practice draws on Theravada Buddhism, with Jack Kornfield, Tara Brach and Tuere Sala among the teachers she names as formative. She came to teaching from work in social and environmental campaigning, and that thread of service still runs through what she does: she leads the Yoga for All Movement, which brings yoga and mindfulness to people in prison and to communities the wellness world tends to overlook.

She directs the Awake Heart 200- and 300-hour yoga and mindfulness teacher trainings, held partly at Mount Madonna Center, and has trained several hundred teachers. Online she guides Shelter in the Heart, a meditation group that meets twice a week with a dharma talk and time for journaling and sharing, and The Ritual, a long class that mixes breath, movement, music and storytelling. She also teaches in person at Pleasure Point Yoga in Santa Cruz. For over a decade she has led pilgrimages to temples in southern India, alongside service trips to Guatemala and retreats at Esalen, where she uses myths and archetypes as a way into practice. She has appeared at Wanderlust, Bhakti Fest and Electric Forest.

courses.title: Mythology, Yoga, and Falling in Love with Existence at the Edge of the World
courses.description: A five-day Esalen retreat that uses a myth each day as the starting point for practice. Sessions mix yoga for all levels, breathwork, meditation, dance, writing and outdoor ceremony, with plenty of time for meals and the baths.

courses.title: Shelter in the Heart Meditation Group
courses.description: An online sangha that meets on Zoom twice a week for a dharma talk and a 45-minute guided sitting, followed by optional journaling and sharing. It runs as a monthly closed group open to beginners and longtime meditators, with sliding-scale rates.

courses.title: Shelter in the Heart + Movement Membership
courses.description: The online meditation group plus four live yoga classes a month, covering flow, restorative practice and breathwork, with replays to practise again later. Priced on a sliding scale.

courses.title: Private Sessions
courses.description: One-hour individual sessions in yoga and meditation, shaped around what the student brings. Paid on a sliding scale in the spirit of dana.

courses.title: Sacred India: Devotional Pilgrimage to the Heartland of Yoga
courses.description: A 13-night guided journey from Chennai through Tamil Nadu and into Karnataka, visiting ancient temples and other sites of the yoga tradition. At each stop she tells the stories of the deities worshipped there, alongside daily practice.

courses.title: Sacred Service, Sacred Lake: Yoga, Service & Joy in Guatemala
courses.description: A Thanksgiving-week trip with Hug It Forward that pairs daily yoga and mindfulness with helping a rural community build a bottle-brick school. The later days are spent at Lake Atitlán as a practice of karma yoga and seva.
